career_ladder.note: Executive security personnel in Delhi Prisons (Department of Delhi Prisons, GNCTD — Tihar, Rohini, and Mandoli Central Jails) follow the custodial administrative hierarchy from Warder up to Superintendent of Prisons.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Warder and Matron consists of a Two-Stage recruitment process: Stage 1 is a One-Tier General (I-T-G) computer-based examination of 200 marks, followed by Stage 2 Physical Measurement and Physical Endurance Test (PMT & PET) conducted by the Delhi Prisons Department which is qualifying in nature.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: One-Tier Written CBT (Objective MCQ, 2 Hours Duration)
stages.source_label: DSSSB Advt No. 03/2023 — One-Tier General (I-T-G) Scheme for Warder & Matron

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Physical Standards and Endurance Test (PET & PMT)
stages.source_label: DSSSB Advt No. 03/2023 — Physical Measurement & Physical Endurance Standards for Warder & Matron

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement Test (Male: Height ≥ 170 cm, Chest 81-85 cm; Female: Height ≥ 157 cm)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying physical standards (5 cm height relaxation for hill tribes and ST candidates)

papers.paper_name: Physical Endurance Test (Male: 1600m run in 6 min, Long Jump 13 ft, High Jump 3'9"; Female: 800m run in 4 min, Long Jump 9 ft, High Jump 3')
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying in all 3 events (up to 3 attempts allowed for long jump and high jump)

financial_package.note: Warders and Matrons in Delhi Prisons are placed under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 3 (entry basic ₹21,700) and are entitled to specialized prison uniform and security allowances in addition to standard Class 'X' metro allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DSSSB Advt No. 03/2023 — Pay Scale for Warder Post Code 113/23 & Matron Post Code 112/23 (Level 3, ₹21,700 – ₹69,100)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 Entry Basic ₹21,700 + 58% DA (₹12,586) + 30% HRA (₹6,510) + TA (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688) plus Ration Money Allowance (~₹3,500/month) and Washing Allowance giving Gross ~₹48,000–₹50,000; In-Hand ~₹41,000–₹43,000 after 10% NPS deduction (₹3,429) and standard state deductions.
official_perks: Ration Money Allowance (RMA) / Mess Allowance for executive custodial prison security staff
Uniform and Washing Allowance for executive uniformed warder duties
Delhi Government Employees Health Scheme (DGEHS) comprehensive medical facilities
One month extra basic pay (13th Month Salary) or compensatory leave in lieu of duty performed on gazetted holidays and weekends
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly government matching contribution
Government residential quarters inside Delhi Prisons residential complexes (Tihar, Rohini, Mandoli)

competition_benchmarks.note: DSSSB Warder recruitments attract extensive applicant participation across Delhi and northern India. In the 2025 recruitment cycle for Warder (Male) Post Code 15/25 (Advt No. 01/2025), 63,817 candidates appeared in the CBT for 1,676 vacancies, with 16,596 shortlisted for the Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (UR cut-off: 139.35), verified directly from official DSSSB shortlisting results.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 38 (calculated: 63,817 appeared in CBT ÷ 1,676 vacancies)
